item.title: US crude stocks and distillate inventories fall, gasoline inventories rise, the EIA says
item.description: U.S. crude stocks and distillate inventories fell while gasoline inventories rose last week, the Energy Information Administration said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Liz Hampton, Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: U.S. crude stocks and distillate inventories fell while gasoline inventories rose last week, the Energy Information Administration said on Wednesday. Crude inventories fell by 3.2 million barrels to 424.1 million barrels in the week ended October 2, the EIA said, compared with analysts' expectations in a Reuters poll for a 1.7 million-barrel rise. Crude stocks at the Cushing, Oklahoma, delivery hub (USOICC=ECI) rose by 444,000 barrels in the week, the EIA said. Refinery crude runs (USOICR=ECI) rose by 223,000 barrels per day in the week, the EIA said, while utilization rates (USOIRU=ECI) rose by 0.2 percentage points to 92.7%. U.S. gasoline stocks (USOILG=ECI) rose by 0.4 million barrels to 204.7 million barrels, the EIA said, compared with analysts' expectations in a Reuters poll for a 1.7 million-barrel draw. Distillate stockpiles (USOILD=ECI) , which include diesel and heating oil, were little changed in week at 105.1 million barrels, versus expectations for a 2.1 million-barrel drop, the EIA data showed. Net U.S. crude imports (USOICI=ECI) fell last week by 53,000 barrels per day, EIA said.

item.title: Webull sinks after CNBC reports US House panel flagged China ties
item.description: Webull's shares fell more than 18% on Wednesday after CNBC reported that a US congressional panel had found the online trading platform "tied in structural ways" to China's government.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Webull's (BULL.O) shares fell more than 18% on Wednesday after CNBC reported that a US congressional panel had found the online trading platform "tied in structural ways" to China's government. The bipartisan House Select Committee on China, in a report set to be released on Wednesday, found "a profound gap" between the company's public marketing and actual control, the report said. The committee said the company's corporate structure, including "software development, data pipelines, and core engineering operations", was dependent on infrastructure subject directly to Beijing's laws, according to the report. Stock hit its lowest in nearly four months and was on course for the biggest one-day percentage decline since April last year, if current levels hold. Webull, the House committee and a spokesperson for the Chinese embassy in the US did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. "The potential regulatory and operational implications of these findings create a level of uncertainty that we cannot reasonably incorporate into our estimates," Siebert Financial analyst Brian Vieten said, while suspending his buy rating and price target on the stock. The House committee's findings underscore the growing scrutiny in Washington of Chinese links to companies operating in key areas of the US economy, including financial services. Last week, Congressman Ro Khanna, a Democrat, warned that [USN:L1N45M17H TEXT:"Beijing could steal"] AI model weights developed by OpenAI, Anthropic and other top US firms, erasing the US edge over China. US President Donald Trump's lavish three-day summit last month for Chinese President Xi Jinping also [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"delivered no breakthroughs"] on thorny issues such as AI, trade, Taiwan and the war with Iran.

item.title: Arsenal plot football domination after title win, says CEO Garlick
item.description: Arsenal are in a strong position to dominate men's football for years to come, CEO Richard Garlick said on Wednesday, minutes after the club announced they had agreed a new long-term deal for manager Mikel Arteta.
item.dc:creator: Christian Radnedge
item.content:encoded: Arsenal are in a strong position to dominate men's football for years to come, CEO Richard Garlick said on Wednesday, minutes after the club announced they had agreed a new long-term deal for manager Mikel Arteta. Arteta ended the club's 22-year wait for a Premier League title in May and [USN:L6N45T0OF TEXT:"has extended his contract to 2030"]. The club also reached the Champions League final, losing on penalties to Paris St Germain, and posted club-record revenue. Garlick said, however, they were not resting on their laurels as they seek to build on a stellar campaign on and off the pitch. "We can't stand still. We can't sit there, pat ourselves on the back, and say job done. This is the beginning, not the end of our journey. This is where we want to go on and show the confidence that that win is going to bring to us," Garlick said at the Leaders Week sports industry conference at Stamford Bridge. "We want to dominate football for the next number of years. We're in a really strong position to do that, but... we need to keep finding that edge that gives us that advantage, and we have to be brave because it'd be very easy just to simply say 'we'll just roll over what we did last year, and that'll be enough', because everybody's out to get you. "When you're champions, everybody wants to beat you, and we need to find a way of taking those opportunities and taking those advantages and pushing forward all the time." Arsenal were ranked seventh in the [USN:L8N3YN0XB TEXT:"2026 Deloitte money league"] for the world's top revenue-generating clubs, behind Manchester City. However, with City being found guilty of all charges relating to breaches of the Premier League's financial rules from 2009-10 to 2017-18, there may be a gap to exploit in English football. City have appealed the league's decision and continue to deny wrongdoing. FAITH IN ARTETA Arsenal, owned by American company Kroenke Sports & Entertainment, will be helped by club-record revenue of 822 million euros ($918.91 million) in 2025, a 15% increase from the previous year and more expected this year. With Arteta's mentor Pep Guardiola having left City in the close season, the Arsenal manager is now the longest-serving manager in the league after joining in December 2019. Garlick sees that faith in Arteta, who struggled early on in his tenure, as key to Arsenal's growing success. "I think it gives us a competitive advantage over the other teams because... Mikel is the only manager that's won the Premier League that's currently managing," Garlick said. "You look at all the other teams in the sort of traditional top six, and they've all gone through managerial changes... whereas we've now got a manager who's been with us for a significant period of time and has been allowed to build and develop a team over a period of time. "And the excitement now is we see (the) platform that we've got and we build from there." Arsenal are second in the Premier League standings with 12 points from five games and host Leeds United on Saturday. ($1 = 0.8945 euros)

item.title: Belgian students rally over education costs in protests echoing France
item.description: Hundreds of students, inspired in part by educational unrest in neighbouring France, have taken to the streets of the Belgian city of Liège, with local media reporting 107 arrests in recent days.
item.dc:creator: Bart Biesemans
item.content:encoded: Hundreds of students, inspired in part by educational unrest [USN:L1N45T0B2 TEXT:"in neighbouring France"], have taken to the streets of the Belgian city of Liège, with local media reporting 107 arrests in recent days. Local authorities could not immediately be reached to confirm the arrests, which the Belga news agency reported were linked to offences including property damage and arson. Students have protested over Belgium's French-language education system, citing rising education costs, overcrowded classrooms and difficulties accessing study materials. They held signs with slogans including "It's a mess, we are fighting for a right! Not a privilege!" and "I chose education, not the hunger games!!". The unrest follows June clashes between protesters and police in Brussels over education reforms, including a tuition increase for most students in Belgium's French-speaking Community to €1,194 ($1,280) from €835. Videos circulating on social media in recent days showed shattered glass, fires and hundreds of mostly young protesters in Liège, while other footage showed police blocking roads. During Wednesday's protest, police were seen checking students for weapons. IN TOUCH WITH FRENCH STUDENTS Some students told Reuters they were in touch with French counterparts. "We support each other because we're facing pretty much the same issues," 19-year-old student Alfred said. Amelia Di Salve, also 19, who is studying to become a teacher, said Belgium's student movement began earlier this year and was reignited after students saw the demonstrations in France. "When we saw nothing was changing without protests, we decided we would start ... France did influence us a little," she said. Liège mayor Willy Demeyer told Belgian broadcaster RTBF he hoped calm would return and "that dialogue can be established and that the young people can express their grievances in a peaceful way and, if possible, have those concerns heard".

item.title: 米政府とグーグル、メタＣＥＯのバイオハブに参画 生物学ＡＩに18億ドル投資へ
item.description:
Krystal Hu
[７日 ロイター] - 米政府と米メタ・プラットフォームズ、グーグル親会社のアルファベットが、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米政府とグーグル、メタＣＥＯのバイオハブに参画　生物学ＡＩに18億ドル投資へ 23:26 配信

米メタのマーク・ザッカーバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と妻のプリシラ・チャン氏。2025年4月、カリフォルニア州サンタモニカで撮影。REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni

Krystal Hu

[７日　ロイター] - 米政府と米メタ・プラットフォームズ、グーグル親会社のアルファベットが、非営利研究機関「バイオハブ」に参画し、生物学研究用の人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルの学習に向けたオープンデータセットの構築に乗り出す。この取り組みへの投資総額は１８億ドルに達する見通し。バイオハブが７日に明らかにした。

「バイオハブ」にはメタ、グーグル傘下グーグル・ディープマインド、創薬スタートアップのアイソモルフィックラボが共同で３億ドルを投じる。米エネルギー省は実験室での測定、モデリング、計算に今後５年間で５億ドル超を拠出する。また、米国立衛生研究所（ＮＩＨ）は、５億ドル超の連邦資金でこれまでに構築されたデータセットとリポジトリを調整し、バイオハブがこれらをＡＩの訓練用に標準化する。

バイオハブはメタのマーク・ザッカーバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と妻のプリシラ・チャン氏による慈善事業として運営されている。

モデル訓練向けの生物学データの獲得を巡っては、アンソロピックやオープンＡＩも同様の取り組みを進めている。アンソロピックはＡＩ技術を応用した医薬品開発の本格化に向け、生物学の研究を行うための実験施設（ウェットラボ）を開設した。オープンＡＩ財団はＡＩ研究向けの生物・医療データセット構築のため、１億２５００万ドル超の助成プログラムを開始した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：空前のＡＩ投資、相応の経済効果実現へなお高いハードル アングル：ＡＩ競争でグーグル躍進、ウォール街も設備投資急増への評価一変 コラム：グーグル、ＡＩブームの賭けで存在感 アングル：ウクライナ、グーグルと独自ＡＩシステム開発　決め手は多言語対応 アングル：ＡＩハードウエア競争、グーグル「手本はエヌビディア」 最終更新: 10/7(水) 23:26 ロイター

item.title: Kenya central bank keeps main lending rate unchanged
item.description: Kenya's central bank maintained its benchmark lending rate at 8.75%, it said on Wednesday after a meeting of its Monetary Policy Committee.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenya's central bank maintained its benchmark lending rate (KECBIR=ECI) at 8.75%, it said on Wednesday after a meeting of its Monetary Policy Committee. It was the fourth policy meeting in a row that the Central Bank of Kenya has kept the rate unchanged. A Reuters poll of 11 economists had nine predicting a hold, while two had predicted a raise to 9.0%. Kenya's inflation (KECPI=ECI) rose to 6.8% year-on-year in September from 6.6% a month earlier, moving closer to the upper end of the government's preferred 2.5%-7.5% range. Inflation is expected to remain within the target range in the near term, the bank said in a statement.

item.title: Attacks on tankers in Hormuz hit highest of any week since start of Iran war, sources say
item.description: Attacks on tankers sailing through the Strait of Hormuz hit their highest last week of any week since the Iran war began, according to maritime security sources tracking incidents, amid a bigger export push by Gulf producers.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Saul
item.content:encoded: Attacks on tankers sailing through the Strait of Hormuz hit their highest last week of any week since the Iran war began, according to maritime security sources tracking incidents, amid a bigger export push by Gulf producers. Attacks, attempted attacks and harassment activity including drone overflights, surveillance and hailing using VHF radio by Iran's Revolutionary Guards have persisted in the strait, the US Navy-led Joint Maritime Information Center (JMIC) said in a note on Sunday. "These actions continue to demonstrate Iran’s intent to assert presence along key transit lanes and maintain pressure on transiting vessels," the JMIC said. In the week of September 28-October 5, there had been at least 12 attacks on oil, liquefied natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas tankers around the Strait of Hormuz, according to data from three maritime security sources who analysed incidents based on information received from the area. That was the highest number of attacks in a single week since the US war with Iran began on February 28, the sources said. Separate data collated by the UN's shipping agency, the International Maritime Organization (IMO), showed nine incidents involving vessels in the same week. The UN body tends to take longer to verify and officially record incidents, maritime sources say. The closest week in terms of comparable incidents was the week of July 13 when there were eight incidents, separate IMO data showed. Gulf oil exporters topped [USN:L1N45R04U TEXT:"pre-war levels for about half of September"], shipping data showed on Monday, though attacks on tankers and logistical constraints cloud the outlook for sustained higher flows. India's foreign ministry said on Tuesday that 12 crew members [USN:L4N45S0VH TEXT:"were injured"] after an unknown projectile struck Panama-flagged oil tanker On Peace while it was passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Bolsa mexicana cae luego de tres sesiones de alzas, espera minutas Fed
item.description: La bolsa mexicana caía el miércoles y cortaba una racha de tres alzas consecutivas ante un menor apetito por el riesgo debido al alza del petróleo y a la espera de la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La bolsa mexicana caía el miércoles y cortaba una racha de tres alzas consecutivas ante un menor apetito por el riesgo debido al alza del petróleo y a la espera de la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos. El índice líder S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que agrupa a las acciones más negociadas del mercado local, perdía un 0.68% a 64,867.87 puntos, en línea con la fuerte baja de Wall Street después de que el S&P 500 y el Nasdaq cerraran en la víspera en máximos récord. Los títulos del Grupo Aeroportuario GAP (GAPB.MX) lideraban los descensos del mercado bursátil local con una pérdida de 2.68% a 367,98 pesos. Les seguían las acciones de la cementera Cemex , que perdían un 2.23% a 17.56 pesos. Los precios del crudo subían el miércoles y los futuros del Brent se mantenían por sobre los 100 dólares el barril, lo que mantenía las preocupaciones sobre las presiones inflacionarias. Más tarde, la Fed divulgará las minutas de su último encuentro, en el que subió las tasas de interés al rango del 3.75%-4% y señaló que podrían producirse nuevas alzas.

item.title: Lebanon's Hezbollah gets $200 million from Iran to help displaced, sources say
item.description: Hezbollah has received $200 million from Iran to help Lebanese displaced by this year’s war with Israel, two people with direct knowledge of the transfer said, the first significant aid from the group to supporters who bore the brunt of the conflict.
item.dc:creator: Laila Bassam, Maya Gebeily
item.content:encoded: Hezbollah has received $200 million from Iran to help Lebanese displaced by this year’s war with Israel, two people with direct knowledge of the transfer said, the first significant aid from the group to supporters who bore the brunt of the conflict. [USN:L1N42A08R TEXT:"Hezbollah"] received the cash last month despite a tightening US economic [USN:L8N44N1OO TEXT:"chokehold"] on Iran and increasing difficulties in getting funds to Tehran's Lebanese ally, said the people. Intermediaries who moved the money charged a 20% fee, reflecting the risks of dealing with the group, they said. One said this was four times the normal fee. Asked for comment, a Hezbollah official said an amount had been secured and a plan for distributing it would be announced in the coming days, without elaborating on the source of the funds. The Iranian foreign ministry, Iran's permanent mission in Geneva, the US State Department and the Lebanese government did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Israel’s bombardment and invasion of Lebanon [USN:L8N4241VG TEXT:"uprooted "]hundreds of thousands of Hezbollah’s Shi’ite Muslim constituents after the group entered the regional war in support of Iran on March 2. But those displaced have so far received little to no assistance from Hezbollah, an armed group founded by Iran’s Revolutionary Guards in 1982 which has suffered heavy Israeli blows in two wars since 2024 and is designated a terrorist group by Washington. AIDING 50,000 FAMILIES Hezbollah would use the funds to pay an initial $3,000 per family, and priority will go to those whose villages have been destroyed or are inaccessible due to Israeli occupation, the sources said. These number around 50,000 families, one of the sources said. Iran has maintained financial support to Hezbollah through years of crippling US sanctions: it transferred $1 billion to the group in the first 10 months of 2025, according to the US Treasury Department. Tehran has never acknowledged financing Hezbollah. Iran's policy of funding regional proxies has stirred domestic protester anger against the clerical rulers in the past and could prove particularly sensitive at a time of [USN:L6N45K0UX TEXT:"worsening hardship in Iran"]. Iran had [USN:L8N42P09O TEXT:"promised Hezbollah"] more funding after Tehran signed an interim deal with Washington in June that allowed Iran to sell its oil, Reuters reported at the time. That agreement collapsed in July. Washington has since intensified economic pressure on Iran, tightening sanctions and imposing a naval blockade to block Iranian oil exports. Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem said in a speech last month that the group would soon contribute to a project aimed at housing thousands of people displaced by the war, using “available resources and donations”, without elaborating. Hezbollah's ability to fund local services and provide post-conflict aid has helped shore up its support in the past. Following a war with Israel in 2006, the group immediately handed out large cash payments to those impacted and moved swiftly to help rebuild Beirut's southern suburbs, a stronghold. But this time there has been little sign of reconstruction. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam said last month that the total reconstruction costs from the two wars since 2024 could exceed $27 billion. A COSTLY WAR The two sources provided no details on how the money got to Lebanon. One of them said it was increasingly difficult for Hezbollah to move funds via financial companies that once processed such transfers. Such firms based in Iraq and Dubai were no longer an option, and they were also now under pressure in Turkey, this source said. Hezbollah’s foes believed money was currently the group’s “oxygen”, the source added. Despite the difficulties securing funding, the group had not stopped paying its fighters and the family members of those killed in combat, this source said. In Lebanon, the war has inflicted a heavy price on the Shi’ite Muslim community from which Hezbollah draws support. Israel has razed villages across a swathe of territory it has seized in the south, saying it aims to shield northern Israel from Hezbollah attack. Israeli attacks in Lebanon have killed more than 4,300 people since March 2, according to Lebanon’s health ministry. Its toll does not say how many combatants may be among the dead. Hezbollah has not disclosed figures on its war dead. Reuters reported on May 4 that several thousand Hezbollah fighters had been killed in the war.

item.title: Na Semana de Moda de Paris verões mais longos e quentes representam novo desafio
item.description: Verões mais longos e quentes estão perturbando o calendário sazonal da moda, forçando as marcas de luxo a adaptar seus designs e ameaçando as vendas de roupas de inverno, que geram margens de lucro mais altas.
item.dc:creator: Helen Reid
item.content:encoded: Verões mais longos e quentes estão perturbando o calendário sazonal da moda, forçando as marcas de luxo a adaptar seus designs e ameaçando as vendas de roupas de inverno, que geram margens de lucro mais altas. O ciclo tradicional do setor há muito depende da compra de roupas de outono e inverno pelos consumidores à medida que as temperaturas caem. Mas os outonos mais quentes estão adiando a demanda por casacos e outras peças para o frio, deixando os varejistas expostos ao risco de excesso de estoque e descontos. Em Paris, os outdoors da Saint Laurent durante a Semana da Moda mostravam uma modelo envolta em um casaco de pele grosso, enquanto o Sol brilhava e os turistas passeavam pelas ruas vestindo camisetas e shorts. “Todo o setor deve perceber que, com as mudanças climáticas e as temperaturas mais altas, a época de vender casacos mudou para mais tarde”, disse Pau Almar, consultor do setor de varejo que trabalhou por uma década na Zara. Essa desconexão ficou evidente durante a Semana da Moda de Paris, onde as temperaturas chegaram a 28 graus Celsius e muitos convidados optaram por blusas sem mangas e minissaias em vez das coleções de outono recém-lançadas. Normalmente, os convidados dos desfiles de primavera/verão, realizados no final de setembro, aparecem vestidos com peças de outono/inverno recém-lançadas nas lojas. No desfile da Louis Vuitton na terça-feira, porém, os casacos eram raros. “Não acredito que já é outubro aqui em Paris e eu estava pensando que deveria ter trazido algumas das minhas roupas de verão de Miami”, disse Suzy Buckley Woodward, uma convidada do desfile. ADAPTAÇÃO DE DESIGNS, RISCOS NO VAREJO O estilista da linha feminina da Louis Vuitton, Nicolas Ghesquière, já está adaptando seus designs, afirmando que as ondas de calor recordes na Europa tiveram uma “forte influência” em sua última coleção, que apresentou tecidos finos e cortes arejados. “O foco foi em como criar roupas que fossem quase como trajes de banho, como uma segunda pele”, disse ele aos repórteres após o desfile de terça-feira. O clima quente da semana passada fez com que alguns convidados, vestidos com roupas de outono, ficassem com calor excessivo no desfile de primavera/verão da Dior nos Jardins das Tulherias, apesar dos ventiladores de teto instalados acima da passarela. As altas temperaturas persistentes também representam um desafio para as redes de varejo de moda de massa, à medida que as lojas começam a substituir camisetas por jaquetas e malhas, enfrentando o risco de ter que dar descontos no estoque excedente. As lojas terão que se adaptar para vender menos casacos pesados e mais peças de transição, disse Almar. Os lucros podem ficar sob pressão, já que os agasalhos costumam ter margens de lucro mais altas, e um inverno atrasado aumenta o risco de mais consumidores esperarem até os descontos da Black Friday, no final de novembro, para comprar um casaco novo.

item.title: Peso mexicano cae a la espera de minutas de Reserva Federal EEUU
item.description: El peso mexicano descendía el miércoles tras dos jornadas de alzas y cotizaba por sobre la barrera de las 18 unidades por dólar ante el avance del billete verde en los mercados globales, mientras esperan la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano descendía el miércoles tras dos jornadas de alzas y cotizaba por sobre la barrera de las 18 unidades por dólar ante el avance del billete verde en los mercados globales, mientras esperan la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal. La moneda local cotizaba en 18.0580 unidades por dólar, con una pérdida del 0.46% frente al precio de referencia de LSEG del martes, y luego de dos días de alzas. La semana pasada llegó a negociarse en 18.4330, su nivel más débil desde noviembre de 2025. "Hoy, el peso mexicano se debilita ante un dólar firme, en línea con la mayoría de las divisas de economías emergentes, ya que regresaron las condiciones de aversión global al riesgo y las preocupaciones inflacionarias. Los niveles de soporte y resistencia se ubican en $17.98 y $18.18 respectivamente, en el mercado interbancario", dijo la correduría Monex en un reporte. El dólar subía frente a las principales divisas en la jornada impulsado por el alza de los precios del petróleo, mientras los inversores esperan las minutas de la última reunión de la Fed en que el banco central subió la tasa de interés en 25 puntos básicos al rango del 3.75%-4%, y señaló que podrían producirse nuevas alzas para contener la inflación.

item.title: Pfizer to cut around 330 jobs in Italy
item.description: Pfizer will cut around 330 jobs in Italy at its Sicily plant, labour unions said on Wednesday, making the US drugmaker the latest international company downsizing its Italian operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pfizer (PFE.N) will cut around 330 jobs in Italy at its Sicily plant, labour unions said on Wednesday, making the US drugmaker the latest international company downsizing its Italian operations. Talks in Rome between Pfizer and Italy's industry ministry late on Tuesday did not yield results, the CGIL, CISL and UIL unions said in a statement. Pfizer's Sicily plant currently has 550 employees, unions said. Pfizer was not immediately available for comment. Italy's industry ministry said "the points raised during the meeting serve as a starting point for strengthening the dialogue," adding that industry minister Adolfo Urso would visit the plant on October 23. Further talks between Pfizer and the ministry are scheduled for November 10, the ministry added. Earlier this week, appliance maker Electrolux (ELUXb.ST) [USN:L1N45R0PJ TEXT:"presented"] a scaled-down restructuring plan for its Italian operations, with around 1,250 jobs now expected to be made redundant. Swedish telecoms equipment maker Ericsson (ERICb.ST) also said on Monday that, following talks with the ministry, a collective layoff of 131 workers in Genoa would be dropped in favour of a voluntary restructuring plan.

item.title: Eritrean troops drive through northern Ethiopian town, witnesses say
item.description: Eritrean soldiers drove through the northern Ethiopian town of Adigrat on Wednesday, two witnesses told Reuters, days after the Horn of Africa neighbours severed diplomatic ties, raising fears of outright conflict.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Eritrean soldiers drove through the northern Ethiopian town of Adigrat on Wednesday, two witnesses told Reuters, days after the Horn of Africa neighbours [USN:L6N45N0FL TEXT:"severed diplomatic ties"], raising [USN:L6N45M0WY TEXT:"fears of outright conflict"]. The sightings of Eritrean troops would be the first confirmation of their presence on Ethiopian soil during the conflict in the country's north between the federal government and a rebel alliance that broke out last month. Eritrea’s information minister Yemane Gebremeskel denied Eritrean forces were there, calling the witness accounts part of an Ethiopian plan to justify a war of aggression against its smaller neighbour. Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of backing the rebel alliance battling federal government troops since September 23 in the northern regions of Tigray, Amhara and Afar. Afar's chief administrator said last week that Eritrean troops were fighting in his region, but Reuters could not confirm that. Asmara has denied the allegations, which led to the severing of diplomatic ties last week. Spokespeople for Ethiopia's government and Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed did not immediately respond to requests for comment. WITNESSES SAW ERITREAN TROOPS DRIVING THROUGH TOWN Two residents of Adigrat, a town in Tigray about 25 km (15 miles) south of the Eritrean border that has not experienced clashes during the current conflict, said they had seen two trucks with dozens of Eritrean soldiers driving through the town on Wednesday morning. They said they could identify the soldiers as Eritrean by their off-white camouflage uniforms. Another Adigrat resident who was not in town at the time said family members had told him they had also seen Eritrean troops. Reuters could not independently verify their accounts. All spoke on condition of anonymity because of security concerns related to the ongoing conflict. The Eritrean information minister Yemane said the allegations were intended to provide Ethiopia with a pretext to attack Eritrea. For over three years, Abiy and other Ethiopian officials have repeatedly said that sea access is vital for their landlocked country's security and economy. Asmara views those comments as an implicit threat against it, while Addis Ababa has said it aims to gain sea access peacefully. Ethiopia “has tried to re-package this war agenda in terms of self-defence by fabricating various allegations against Eritrea,” Yemane said. “So we connect the dots.” NORTHERN ETHIOPIA CONFLICT FUELS FEARS OF WIDER WAR Eritrean soldiers fought in support of Ethiopia’s federal government during a 2020-2022 civil war in Tigray. Some of them remained in northern parts of Tigray close to the border well after the war ended, according to Ethiopia’s government, UN experts and human rights organisations. Eritrea denied this. The fighting that broke out last month has raised fear that unrest could spread beyond Ethiopia’s borders in an increasingly fragile region where other powers are competing for influence. Tigray has Ethiopia's longtime foe Eritrea to its north, and Sudan — caught up in a more than three-year-old civil war — to its west. Ethiopia's government has also accused Egypt and Sudan of supporting the opposition alliance. Both have denied this. On Saturday, the US State Department urged Asmara and Addis Ababa to exercise restraint, warning that a conflict would jeopardise US collaboration with both countries. Eritrea, a former province of Ethiopia, won its statehood in 1993 after a 30-year independence struggle. The two countries fought a border war from 1998-2000 that killed tens of thousands. They normalised diplomatic relations in 2018, winning Abiy the Nobel Peace Prize, but relations soured once again during the 2020-2022 Tigray war.

item.title: イラン高官、米の核開発巡る「考え」相いれず 核濃縮はレッドライン
item.description: [ドバイ ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ ７日 ロイター] - イラン当局者は７日、同国の核開発計画に関する米国の「要求や構想」はイラン側の要求と相いれないとの認識を示した。

バンス米副大統領が、イランは米国の要求を満たし７カ月に及ぶ戦争を終結させるためには、ウラン濃縮能力を「意味のある形で」削減する必要があるとの考えを示したことについて、当局者はロイターに対し、「バンス氏の発言は米政権の考えや要求を反映したものだ。米国側には要求を示し、自らの考えを持つ自由があるが、その内容はイランの要求とは相いれない」と語った。

さらに、イランの核開発計画を巡り、米国との交渉は一切行われておらず、核協議を開始するには米国がイラン側の条件を満たす必要があると述べた。また、核濃縮に関する条件はイランにとっての「レッドライン（越えられない一線）」であり、「この点についてはいかなる形でも柔軟性を示すことはない」とした。ただ、濃縮の詳細を巡り後日協議することは可能との認識も示した。

item.title: Analysis:Crypto donors navigate mid-term spending dilemma after Senate bill defeat
item.description: Oct 7 : After suffering a major legislative defeat at the hands of Senate Democrats last month, the crypto industry is grappling with a dilemma three weeks out from the November election: punish Democrats, or preserve the bipartisan ties it has spent years building. During the current and previous election cy
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Analysis:Crypto donors navigate mid-term spending dilemma after Senate bill defeat

FILE PHOTO: The dome of the U.S. Capitol Building is reflected in a puddle on a rainy morning in Washington February 2, 2012. REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque/File Photo

07 Oct 2026 10:08PM (Updated: 07 Oct 2026 10:15PM)

FAST

Oct 7 : After suffering a major legislative defeat at the hands of Senate Democrats last month, the crypto industry is grappling with a dilemma three weeks out from the November election: punish Democrats, or preserve the bipartisan ties it has spent years building. During the current and previous election cycles, the industry has spent more than $300 million backing crypto-friendly Democrats and Republicans in roughly equal measure, hoping to pass legislation US crypto companies say will put them on a solid legal footing and allow them to thrive. That strategy paid off with last year's new law promoting dollar-backed cryptocurrencies, but suffered a major blow last month when all Senate Democrats and a handful of Republicans voted against advancing the Clarity Act, which the industry says would have provided the legal clarity it has long lobbied for. US President Donald Trump's personal crypto ventures became a flashpoint in the bill negotiations, prompting Democrats to push for tougher restrictions on officeholders' crypto dealings. Their decision to vote against the bill despite winning many concessions angered crypto executives, while the broader fight has made crypto more of a partisan issue, said analysts.

Nine Democrats are up for reelection in the Senate, including some the industry had viewed as allies. With polls showing the party has a slight edge, the crypto industry is weighing whether to continue with its bipartisan strategy in the Senate, or to reward Republicans, who overwhelmingly supported Clarity, said four executives involved in the discussions. While it's unlikely a Democratic-led Senate will pass crypto legislation, turning the midterms into a referendum on Clarity could squander years of relationship-building and alienate lawmakers who may be in power next year, some executives warn. “It's a pretty hard needle to thread," said Ron Hammond, head of policy and advocacy at crypto trading firm Wintermute, adding that the big crypto spenders have been "navigating this very carefully." CRYPTO HAS PUNISHED ADVERSARIES BEFORE Fairshake, a crypto super PAC backed by Coinbase and Ripple among others, started the year with $193 million. On Monday, it said it would back 32 House candidates spanning both parties, but has not announced a Senate strategy. It has spent on 57 races this cycle, winning many. “Fairshake has always been and always will be an issue-focused organization. We back pro-crypto candidates who support American innovation in both parties," said spokesperson Geoff Vetter. Crypto PACs have previously targeted vulnerable adversaries. In 2024, Fairshake spent about $40 million successfully unseating former incumbent Ohio Senate Democrat Sherrod Brown, who criticized the industry's Washington influence. In a sign of what may come, the PAC is spending $30 million opposing his bid to return to the Senate. Digital Freedom Fund, a super PAC backed by crypto entrepreneurs Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, is also spending $3 million opposing Brown and supporting current Ohio Republican Senator Jon Husted, who voted for Clarity, federal filings show. It's also spending $400,000 in the race for Iowa's open Senate seat, splitting the cash between backing pro-crypto Republican Ashley Hinson and opposing her Democratic rival. Spokespeople for the Winklevoss twins and Hinson did not respond to requests for comment. Ripple declined to comment. A spokesperson for Brown's campaign accused Husted of being "for sale." A Husted campaign spokesperson said Brown was "terrified of having his abysmal record splashed across TV screens." Until recently, the industry's aggressive spending made candidates think twice about crossing it, analysts say, but executives worry it's a risky strategy, especially against incumbents. Many believe crypto can still be a bipartisan issue and that the industry should find ways to settle scores without jeopardizing those ties. Among those up for reelection, for example, are New Jersey's Cory Booker and Virginia's Mark Warner, both senior Democratic lawmakers whom the industry sees as key allies. They broadly supported crypto legislation but ultimately opposed Clarity, citing insufficient curbs on officeholder crypto dealings. Warner and Booker sit on the Senate Banking and Agriculture committees respectively, which jointly drafted the bill. With both senators in relatively safe races, attacking them could backfire, executives said. Spokespeople for the senators' campaigns did not respond to requests for comment. Senate control would also hand Democrats committee oversight powers which they plan to use to probe crypto companies with ties to Trump. In what analysts said was a potentially ironic twist, there is a chance that Brown, whom recent polls put slightly ahead of Husted, could reprise his leadership of the Banking Committee if he wins. One of the crypto executives who wished to remain anonymous said attacking Democrats "didn't do us a lot of good," and others expect the industry will ultimately focus on rewarding friends in either party. "I do think you're going to see the industry lick its wounds and get back aggressively to supporting the pro-Clarity type folks," said Josh Riezman, chief legal and strategy officer at crypto firm GSR. Stand With Crypto, a nonprofit backed by Coinbase, has endorsed dozens of candidates and is spending on advertising in some races. Its executive director Mason Lynaugh last month warned that the Clarity vote had exposed which officials were "against" the industry. But most of its latest endorsements are for House or Senate lawmakers who voted for Clarity on both sides of the aisle. “We have the potential to move the outcomes or at least play a significant factor in helping reelect these crypto champions," said Lynaugh.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Gobierno EEUU y Google se unen a Biohub, que busca recopilar datos sobre biología aplicada a la IA
item.description: El Gobierno de Estados Unidos y los gigantes tecnológicos Meta Platforms y Alphabet , matriz de Google, se unen a la organización sin ánimo de lucro Biohub para crear conjuntos de datos abiertos con los que entrenar modelos de IA destinados a la investigación biológica, lo que eleva la inversión total en esta iniciativa a 1.800 millones de dólares, dijo Biohub el miércoles.
item.dc:creator: Krystal Hu
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno de Estados Unidos y los gigantes tecnológicos Meta Platforms y Alphabet , matriz de Google, se unen a la organización sin ánimo de lucro Biohub para crear conjuntos de datos abiertos con los que entrenar modelos de IA destinados a la investigación biológica, lo que eleva la inversión total en esta iniciativa a 1.800 millones de dólares, dijo Biohub el miércoles. Meta (META.O) , Google DeepMind y la startup dedicada al descubrimiento de fármacos Isomorphic Labs invertirán conjuntamente 300 millones de dólares. El Departamento de Energía invertirá más de 500 millones de dólares a lo largo de cinco años en mediciones de laboratorio, modelización y cálculo. Los Institutos Nacionales de Salud coordinarán los conjuntos de datos y los repositorios creados con más de 500 millones de dólares de financiación federal anterior, que Biohub estandarizará para el entrenamiento de la IA. Estos compromisos se suman a los 500 millones de dólares que Biohub —una iniciativa filantrópica del director ejecutivo de Meta, Mark Zuckerberg, y su esposa, la doctora Priscilla Chan— destinó al proyecto en abril. Las inversiones financian la Iniciativa de Biología Virtual, cuyo objetivo es medir cómo responden las células a los cambios en un número de condiciones mucho mayor que el que los científicos han estudiado hasta ahora, y utilizar esos datos para crear modelos predictivos que podrían acortar los plazos de desarrollo de fármacos, que actualmente duran años. "Hasta ahora, la biología ha sido una ciencia basada en el descubrimiento", dijo Chan en una entrevista. "Siempre la hemos considerado un activo de la comunidad, no solo de un grupo, para que pueda ir creciendo con el tiempo". Los conjuntos de datos se harán públicos con el tiempo, pero las empresas que los financian obtienen una ventaja inicial, según Alex Rives, director científico de Biohub. "Con los financiadores comerciales tenemos períodos de embargo durante los cuales los grupos pueden trabajar con los datos, y después estos pasan a estar disponibles como recurso científico público", explicó Rives. Este acuerdo es la forma en que Biohub está atrayendo fondos privados hacia un proyecto que describe como "ciencia abierta". Rives señaló que el trabajo financiado por el Gobierno, que se lleva a cabo en paralelo, no tendrá tales restricciones, y que Biohub tiene previsto dirigirse próximamente a empresas farmacéuticas y organizaciones filantrópicas. Los conjuntos de datos celulares actuales abarcan cientos de millones de células, señaló Rives, mientras que un modelo predictivo preciso requerirá miles de millones y, con el tiempo, billones. El objetivo de Biohub es cerrar esa brecha. "Tenemos que captar el lenguaje de la biología, tenemos que captar el lenguaje de la célula. Y eso no existe hoy en día", afirmó. Los datos procederán de técnicas como la transcriptómica espacial —que cartografía la actividad molecular en el interior de tejidos intactos— y de cribados que registran cómo responden las células a los cambios en el entorno. Gran parte de ellos nunca se han generado de forma coordinada. Rives señaló que este trabajo llevaría normalmente décadas y que los socios pretenden condensarlo en cinco años, con un primer conjunto de datos listo en aproximadamente un año. Espera contar con modelos predictivos precisos en un plazo de cinco años. Otros laboratorios de IA están llevando a cabo iniciativas similares. Anthropic ha redoblado sus esfuerzos en el ámbito de la biología con un laboratorio de experimentación, mientras que la Fundación OpenAI ha puesto en marcha un programa de subvenciones de más de 125 millones de dólares para financiar conjuntos de datos biológicos y médicos destinados a la investigación en IA.

item.title: Revolut will cover costs for customers hit by data hack, Western Europe CEO says
item.description: Revolut will cover the cost of customers wanting to change their identity documents after the London-based bank was tricked into giving hackers the data of hundreds of customers, the company's CEO for Western Europe said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Howcroft
item.content:encoded: Revolut will cover the cost of customers wanting to change their identity documents after the London-based bank was tricked into giving hackers the data of hundreds of customers, the company's CEO for Western Europe said on Wednesday. Revolut, Europe's [USN:L6N45R0BS TEXT:"most valuable startup"], said it had sent the customers' personal data to hackers who had taken control of an Italian government agency email address, in an incident first disclosed [USN:L1N455038 TEXT:"last month"]. Béatrice Cossa-Dumurgier, Revolut's CEO for Western Europe, told BFM TV in an interview that the company would not pay ransoms to hackers, when asked if they had paid one. Revolut[USN:L6N458127 TEXT:" previously said"] it had not received a ransom demand. Cossa-Dumurgier said Revolut had provided assistance for the 680 affected clients, 55 of whom are in France. "If they ever have to change their ID documents, we're taking care of the associated costs", she added, without specifying whether this had happened yet or how much it could cost the company. Financial institutions are required to send customer data to authorities when asked to do so as part of investigations into potential crimes. Matteo Piantedosi, Italy's interior minister, told lawmakers on September 30 that the email address to which Revolut sent customer data came from the Reggio Calabria police's email system, but was an address that had never been used before. Revolut could have and should have verified the request by doing minimal due diligence, the minister said. A spokesperson for Revolut declined to comment on the interior minister's remarks. Cossa-Dumurgier said that government agencies are sometimes the "weak link" in the system and that Revolut's own systems had not been compromised.

item.title: Kremlin diz que teste da França com míssil nuclear faz parte de estratégia antirussa
item.description: O Kremlin afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o teste de lançamento de um míssil com capacidade nuclear pela França demonstrou que a Europa está construindo sua identidade de defesa em torno do confronto com a Rússia, descrevendo a estratégia como um “beco sem saída”.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Kremlin afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o teste de lançamento de um míssil com capacidade nuclear pela França demonstrou que a Europa está construindo sua identidade de defesa em torno do confronto com a Rússia, descrevendo a estratégia como um “beco sem saída”. Na terça-feira, o presidente francês Emmanuel Macron elogiou o teste do míssil balístico lançado de um submarino na costa da Bretanha como uma mensagem “enviada de forma clara e inequívoca para onde quer que deva ser recebida”, sem mencionar diretamente a Rússia. O lançamento ocorreu em meio a tensões crescentes em torno da guerra na Ucrânia, da segurança europeia e da dissuasão nuclear. A Rússia renovou recentemente as advertências de que poderia usar armas nucleares para defender a si mesma e o enclave de Kaliningrado. Questionado sobre o teste, o porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, disse aos repórteres que a Rússia havia recebido a mensagem da França e afirmou que se tratava de um exemplo de obsessão da Europa pela militarização. “Eles estão construindo sua identidade no campo da defesa e da segurança com base no confronto com a Federação Russa. Esse é um caminho sem saída. Como mostra a história, isso não leva a nada de bom”, disse. Peskov afirmou que a Rússia permanece alerta, mas aberta ao diálogo. “Acreditamos que quaisquer problemas devem ser resolvidos não por meio de lançamentos demonstrativos de mísseis, mas por meio do diálogo”, acrescentou.

item.title: ノーベル化学賞の硤合氏、「受賞しても文句言われない」 カガン氏との栄誉に喜び
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ７日 ロイター] - ２０２６年のノーベル化学賞を受賞した硤合憲三・東京理科大名誉教授（７６）は７日、都内の同大で記者会見し、世の中には他に重要な研究が多数あると指摘しつつ、自身の成果が「受賞できても文句は言われないとは（思っていた）」と語った。「研究に対する意味合い、位置付けも今回の受賞で認識していただけた。非常に喜んでいる」と話した。

今年の化学賞は「不斉有機合成における非線形効果と自己触媒作用の発見」を理由に硤合氏と仏パリ第１１大学のアンリ・カガン氏（９５）が共同で受賞した。非対称な「鏡像」分子を巡る長年の謎を解明し、医薬品製造において重要な発見をもたらしたことが評価された。

硤合氏は、尊敬する著名なカガン氏とともに受賞したことをとりわけ喜んでいると語った上で、「暗い地面を頭にヘッドライトだけを着けて、そこをずっとたどって行っているような気分」だったとこれまでの研究を振り返った。「もちろん完全にまだ解明したわけではなく、まだまだわからない面白いことがあるはず。今後ともそういう分野の研究が進むように微力ながら尽力したい」と述べた。

また、受賞により「興味を持たれる方はもちろん、必ずしもそうほどでもなかった方にも、ちょっと気を向けていただけるじゃないかな」「日本は有機合成（研究）の非常に盛んな国。これからますます皆さんが研究成果を出していただけるきっかけになればという風に考えている」とも述べた。

硤合氏は広島県出身。１９７９年に東京大学大学院で博士号を取得した。米ノースカロライナ大学で研究し、帰国後の１９８１年から理科大で教壇に立った。

硤合氏は「傍から見たら苦しいことが続いていたかもしれないけど、全然本人はそうは思ってない。新しい事実がどんどん見つかるわけですからね。それはそれで楽しいというか、感動したことはある」と答えた。理科大の教職員や学生などへの感謝も口にした。研究成果について問われると、幾度も手ぶりを交えて説明する姿が目立った。

一方、研究成果が実際にどういう形で応用されているのかについて問われると「応用ができるに越したことはないが、化学賞だけ皆さん、応用が何にできるかって聞かれるが、物理学賞、宇宙のことってあんまり応用って質問されませんよね。応用オンリーではないとかねがね思っている」と答えた。 日本人としての受賞についての質問には「日本人かどうかというところはあまりこだわりを持っていなくて」と話した。

受賞の連絡は、夕方から夜ごろ、近所のスーパーに１人で食材を買いに出かけている時に電話で受けたという。

（岡坂健太郎　編集：久保信博）

item.title: Report: Alex Cora declines chance to manage Phillies
item.description: Alex Cora turned down another opportunity to manage the Philadelphia Phillies and plans to take the 2027 season off, USA Today reported Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alex Cora turned down another opportunity to manage the Philadelphia Phillies and plans to take the 2027 season off, USA Today reported Wednesday. The report's source was a "high-ranking Phillies executive with direct knowledge" of the talks between Cora and Phillies president of baseball operations Dave Dombrowski. Philadelphia reportedly plans to part ways with interim manager Don Mattingly after falling to the Atlanta Braves in last week's National League wild-card series. Mattingly inherited a team that started 9-19 under Rob Thomson and guided them to a 79-55 mark to finish out the regular season. The Phillies fired Rob Thomson on April 28, three days after the Boston Red Sox fired Cora following a 10-17 start. Dombrowski said he offered the job to Cora at the time but was turned down, prompting the team to turn to Mattingly, who was in his first season as Thomson's bench coach. "It's not the time to talk about it," Mattingly said when he was asked about his future following the elimination by the Braves. "I'm comfortable with whatever they want to do. "I want the best for the Phillies. I loved being in Philly this year. I actually like playing in that environment. I like the environment. It's a rough environment, but it's good." Cora, who turns 51 on Oct. 18, compiled a 620-541 record in two stints as the skipper in Boston (2018-19, 2021-26). He led the Red Sox to a World Series championship in 2018. Mattingly, 65, has a 968-1,005 record as manager of the Los Angeles Dodgers (2011-15), Miami Marlins (2016-22) and Phillies (2026). --Field Level Media

item.title: Core Stack e Green Arrow, progetto data center in Italia da 1 mld euro
item.description: Core Stack, divisione del Gruppo Lazzari dedicata alle infrastrutture digitali, investirà in partnership con Green Arrow Capital oltre 1 miliardo di euro nei prossimi quattro anni per realizzare una rete di 13 data center di medie dimensioni in Italia. Lo hanno annunciato oggi le due società.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Core Stack, divisione del Gruppo Lazzari dedicata alle infrastrutture digitali, investirà in partnership con Green Arrow Capital oltre 1 miliardo di euro nei prossimi quattro anni per realizzare una rete di 13 data center di medie dimensioni in Italia. Lo hanno annunciato oggi le due società. I data center di medie dimensioni saranno alimentati da energia rinnovabile generata in loco. Le società contano di ottenere le autorizzazioni necessarie per i primi due siti, nelle province di Cremona e Verona, entro la fine del 2027, con l’avvio delle operazioni previsto nel primo trimestre del 2028. Dopo i progetti più avanzati nel nord e nel nord-est dell’Italia, l’attenzione si sposterà al centro-sud, hanno detto le società. Lo sviluppo dei data center si avvarrà di una filiera interamente italiana, hanno precisato.

item.title: Aaron Sorkin conta por que fez mais um filme sobre Facebook e como vida real se traduz no cinema
item.description: Aaron Sorkin, o roteirista vencedor do Oscar por “A Rede Social”, não tinha a intenção de fazer outro filme sobre o Facebook.
item.dc:creator: Rollo Ross
item.content:encoded: Aaron Sorkin, o roteirista vencedor do Oscar por “A Rede Social”, não tinha a intenção de fazer outro filme sobre o Facebook. Sorkin vinha tendo dificuldades para encontrar uma ideia para um novo projeto quando conheceu Frances Haugen, uma ex-funcionária do Facebook e denunciante cujas revelações levantaram preocupações sobre o impacto das plataformas de mídia social da empresa na saúde, na segurança e na política global. A história que ele criou, contada no filme “O Outro Lado das Redes”, estreará nos cinemas neste mês. “Eu estava procurando uma boa história e, após um período de cerca de um ano de um bloqueio criativo épico, sem conseguir pensar em nenhuma história, conheci Frances Haugen e, de repente, uma boa história começou a tomar forma na minha cabeça”, disse Sorkin, que também dirigiu o filme, em entrevista à Reuters. “A Rede Social”, lançado em 2010, contava a história da origem do Facebook — que, desde então, mudou seu nome para Meta (META.O) — e tinha Jesse Eisenberg no papel do fundador Mark Zuckerberg. O novo filme gira em torno de Haugen e do jornalista Jeff Horwitz, que escreveu uma série para o Wall Street Journal chamada “The Facebook Files”, iniciada em 2021 e baseada em grande parte nos milhares de documentos internos que ela lhe forneceu. “É uma história de Davi e Golias, mas há dois Davis”, disse Sorkin. “Um deles é Frances. Ela pega uma pedra e a arremessa contra o Facebook, e o outro é o jornalismo impresso. Eles pegam uma pedra e a arremessam contra o setor de tecnologia.” Horwitz, que posteriormente detalhou a história em seu livro de 2023, “Broken Code”, agora trabalha como repórter investigativo para a Reuters e continuou cobrindo a Meta, ganhando este ano o Prêmio Pulitzer na categoria de reportagem de cobertura especializada junto com o colega Engen Tham por reportagens que expuseram como a Meta permitiu que seus chatbots se envolvessem em comportamentos provocativos e arrecadassem bilhões de dólares em receita com anúncios fraudulentos. A Sony Pictures (6758.T) comprou os direitos sobre a história de sua vida em conexão com suas reportagens anteriores sobre o Facebook, quando trabalhava no Wall Street Journal. “O Outro Lado das Redes” é um relato ficcionalizado dos eventos e não se baseia nas reportagens de Horwitz sobre o Facebook, o Instagram ou a Meta desde que ele ingressou na Reuters em 2025. O filme narra os encontros de Haugen com Horwitz a partir de dezembro de 2020 e sua relutância em se manifestar publicamente. Haugen acaba concluindo que as revelações terão mais impacto se seu nome for divulgado e decide falar oficialmente. Ela também testemunha perante o Congresso para explicar como acreditava que o algoritmo do Facebook estava promovendo conteúdo que gerava divisão em busca de lucros. Um porta-voz da Meta se recusou a comentar sobre o filme. Quando Haugen prestou depoimento, o Facebook afirmou que a empresa discordava de sua descrição de como funcionava. Zuckerberg defendeu a empresa em uma postagem no Facebook, escrevendo que “o argumento de que promovemos deliberadamente conteúdo que irrita as pessoas para obter lucro é profundamente ilógico”. Em agosto, a Meta concordou em pagar até US$18 bilhões na próxima década para limitar estritamente o uso do Facebook e do Instagram por adolescentes, conforme um acordo com os Estados dos EUA. A empresa negou qualquer irregularidade e afirmou que garantir que os adolescentes tenham uma “experiência segura e produtiva em nossas plataformas” é um “imperativo absoluto” para a empresa. Embora Horwitz não tenha se envolvido na produção do filme e não tivesse voz ativa sobre seu conteúdo, ele se reuniu com Sorkin e respondeu às perguntas dele sobre o processo de reportagem e sua relação com Haugen. Segundo Horwitz, Sorkin disse que usaria alguma liberdade artística. “Ele me disse que achava que precisaria alterar um pouco a cronologia e alguns detalhes para que a história que tinha em mente funcionasse”, declarou Horwitz, que só leu o roteiro depois que ele ficou pronto. “Ele também me disse que queria tomar algumas liberdades com o ‘Jeff do filme’, que seria uma espécie de personagem fictício, uma síntese de repórteres investigativos. Definitivamente, seria uma situação do tipo ‘inspirado em, não baseado em’.” Sorkin disse que os principais fatos da história são precisos, embora ele tenha precisado criar diálogos e uma linha do tempo para construir uma narrativa cinematográfica envolvente.

item.title: African Union delegation meets Congo rebels, calls for continued peace efforts
item.description: An African Union delegation that met Rwanda-backed rebels in eastern Congo has called for continued engagement in the peace process, as fighting continues despite ongoing mediation efforts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An African Union delegation that met Rwanda-backed rebels in eastern Congo has called for continued engagement in the peace process, as fighting continues despite ongoing mediation efforts. The delegation, which includes three former presidents, Kenya's Uhuru Kenyatta, Ethiopia's Sahle-Work Zewde and Botswana's Mokgweetsi Masisi, met leaders of the AFC/M23 rebel group on Monday, the African Union said in a statement on Wednesday The rebels control large areas of North and South Kivu provinces captured during a lightning offensive last year Congo's government and AFC/M23 signed a declaration in Doha in July 2025, committing to a permanent ceasefire and negotiations towards a broader peace agreement The process has yielded limited progress, including the [USN:L8N4440KH TEXT:"release"] of detainees in August and the recent [USN:L6N44L0IT TEXT:"deployment"] of teams responsible for observing implementation of the ceasefire Yet fighting has continued, with recent clashes concentrated in remote parts of South Kivu's highlands and North Kivu's Masisi territory Parallel mediation efforts involving Congo and Rwanda have also been led by the United States and the African Union, but have so far brought little change on the ground The delegation called for respect of commitments made in Doha, adherence to the ceasefire and cooperation with verification mechanisms It also stressed the need to protect civilians and ensure safe humanitarian access The delegation met with Rwanda's foreign minister on Tuesday and is expected in Kinshasa for consultations with the Congolese government

item.title: Un palestino muere en ataque de colonos israelíes durante cosecha de aceitunas, dicen fuentes oficiales
item.description: Un palestino murió el miércoles durante un ataque perpetrado por colonos israelíes mientras unas personas recolectaban aceitunas cerca de la localidad de Burqa, en la Cisjordania ocupada por Israel, informó el Ministerio de Salud palestino.
item.dc:creator: Mohammed Torokman
item.content:encoded: Un palestino murió el miércoles durante un ataque perpetrado por colonos israelíes mientras unas personas recolectaban aceitunas cerca de la localidad de Burqa, en la Cisjordania ocupada por Israel, informó el Ministerio de Salud palestino. El ataque se produjo en medio de una escalada de violencia por parte de colonos israelíes radicales durante la cosecha de aceitunas palestina, en la que los colonos han disparado munición real contra los agricultores, han agredido a periodistas y han dañado los árboles. El Ejército israelí dijo que tanto soldados como colonos habían abierto fuego en el incidente del miércoles. Según el Ejército, los soldados respondieron a un aviso de que un palestino había lanzado una piedra contra un colono, pero no explicó por qué se encontraban los colonos en la zona. Periodistas de Reuters han sido testigos de varios incidentes en las últimas dos semanas en los que el Ejército israelí y los colonos han impedido a los palestinos acceder a sus olivares. El Ministerio de Salud palestino identificó al fallecido como Ali Hassan Yusor al-Bazzari, de 44 años. No quedó claro de inmediato si lo había matado el Ejército israelí o los colonos. En el funeral celebrado tras el ataque, el hijo de al-Bazzari, Danial, de 12 años, lloró junto al cadáver de su padre, que posteriormente fue cubierto con una bandera palestina. "PARA NOSOTROS, EL OLIVO ES LA VIDA" La cosecha de aceitunas, que se extiende de octubre a noviembre, se ha producido en medio de un recrudecimiento de la violencia en Cisjordania, donde los colonos israelíes han matado al menos a 30 palestinos este año, según la Autoridad Palestina. También se ha informado de que más de 45.000 árboles, entre ellos más de 26.000 olivos, fueron talados o dañados en toda Cisjordania durante el primer semestre de 2026. Los olivos revisten una gran importancia para los palestinos, ya que representan su vínculo con la tierra y constituyen una fuente vital de ingresos, en un contexto de crecientes presiones económicas. "Para nosotros, el olivo es la vida", dijo Tayseer Al-Sheikh, un agricultor palestino de 64 años, de las afueras de la aldea de Rantis, al noroeste de Ramala. El miedo a la violencia de los colonos le impidió acceder a sus olivos y cuidarlos durante un año. Solo pudo acceder a ellos en esta cosecha, acompañado por activistas que le proporcionaban protección. Para Al-Sheikh, la pérdida no se mide únicamente por el número de árboles o la cantidad de aceite producido, sino también por el cambio en la relación de las personas con su tierra. "Antes, todo el mundo solía venir a recoger aceitunas, tanto jóvenes como mayores. Hoy en día, mucha gente tiene miedo de acercarse a sus tierras", dijo a Reuters.

item.title: Stretto di Hormuz, 'rotte illegali' presto chiuse - funzionario Iran
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 15.20 - Le rotte di transito nello Stretto di Hormuz ritenute illegali dall’Iran verranno presto chiuse. Lo ha comunicato un consigliere del comandante delle Guardie Rivoluzionarie all’agenzia di stampa semi-ufficiale Fars News Agency, riferendosi alla rotta meridionale che costeggia il litorale dell'Oman. Mohammadreza Naqdi ha detto che queste "poche rotte" sono state create facendo saltare in aria e danneggiando alcuni dei passaggi rocciosi della via d'acqua strategica e vengono utilizzate da "piccole imbarcazioni che contrabbandano petrolio e lo trasferiscono alle petroliere", contestando la tesi secondo cui le esportazioni di greggio del Golfo starebbero tornando ai livelli pre-bellici. "Lo Stretto di Hormuz è chiuso e le forze armate della Repubblica Islamica iraniana ne hanno il pieno controllo. Questa situazione continuerà finché le legittime richieste dell’Iran non saranno soddisfatte", ha aggiunto. 13.15 - Gli Houthi yemeniti hanno attaccato l'aeroporto internazionale di Aden con missili balistici e droni carichi di esplosivo. Lo ha comunicato il ministero dei Trasporti del Paese, mentre si intensificano gli scontri tra il gruppo filoiraniano e le forze governative sostenute dall'Arabia Saudita. La coalizione a guida saudita ha detto di aver intercettato e distrutto un missile balistico Houthi a nord della capitale saudita Riyadh e di star monitorando la piattaforma di lancio a Sanaa, controllata dagli Houthi, che sarebbe stata distrutta, senza tuttavia fornire dettagli su eventuali vittime o danni. Il portavoce militare degli Houthi, Yahya Saree, ha detto in un comunicato che il gruppo ha preso di mira l'aeroporto internazionale Re Khalid di Riyadh con diversi droni. L'Arabia Saudita non ha rilasciato alcuna conferma immediata riguardo all'attacco all'aeroporto.

item.title: L'OMS demande plus d'informations à Moscou sur le décès d'une employée d'un institut dédié à la peste
item.description: L'Organisation mondiale de la santé a déclaré mercredi avoir demandé à la Russie davantage d'informations sur les causes du décès d'une employée d'un institut spécialisé dans la peste en Sibérie, soulignant que la transparence était essentielle pour se faire une idée précise des risques sanitaires potentiels.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'Organisation mondiale de la santé a déclaré mercredi avoir demandé à la Russie davantage d'informations sur les causes du [USN:L6N45R0QR TEXT:"décès d'une employé"]e d'un institut spécialisé dans la peste en Sibérie, soulignant que la transparence était essentielle pour se faire une idée précise des risques sanitaires potentiels. Les autorités russes affirment que cette employée de laboratoire âgée de 28 ans est décédée vendredi d'une pneumonie dont l'origine n'a pas encore été établie, dans une affaire qui a suscité l'inquiétude de la communauté internationale, notamment du président américain Donald Trump, et qui a conduit à la mise en quarantaine initiale d'environ 200 personnes. L'agence russe de surveillance sanitaire a déclaré mardi qu'[USN:L8N45S14O TEXT:"aucun cas de peste"] n'avait été détecté parmi les personnes ayant été en contact avec la défunte, Darya Shipilova, et un responsable local a indiqué que 60% des personnes placées en quarantaine avaient été autorisées à quitter celle-ci. Mais Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, directeur général de l'OMS, basé à Genève, a déclaré dans un communiqué publié sur X que son organisation avait besoin de plus d'informations de la part de la Russie pour comprendre pleinement ce qui s'est passé. "L'OMS a demandé des informations complémentaires afin de clarifier la cause de cette pneumonie grave, l'agent pathogène à l'origine des mesures de santé publique, ainsi que les informations relayées par les médias concernant un deuxième employé atteint d'une pneumonie d'origine indéterminée", a-t-il déclaré. Certains médias occidentaux ont rapporté - en citant des "médias russes" anonymes - qu'une deuxième personne était décédée en Sibérie, affirmant qu'elle était morte de la peste. Reuters n'a trouvé aucune information de ce type dans les médias russes ni aucune preuve qu’une deuxième personne soit décédée en Sibérie. Néanmoins, la demande de Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus sur un complément d'information fait écho à celle du secrétaire d’État américain Marco Rubio, qui a déclaré que Moscou devait communiquer davantage sur cet incident. Si l'autorité sanitaire russe a dit que Darya Shipilova était décédée des suites d'une pneumonie, elle n'a pas expliqué publiquement quelle en était la cause ni comment elle était tombée malade. La pneumonie peut avoir diverses causes, dont la peste. La Russie a informé l'Organisation mondiale de la santé du décès d'un employé de laboratoire dans un institut de recherche sur la peste en Sibérie la semaine dernière, conformément aux procédures en vigueur, a déclaré mercredi le porte-parole du Kremlin, Dmitri Peskov. Ce dernier a accusé les médias de diffuser de fausses informations sur cette affaire. Il a notamment réagi à un reportage d'ABC News selon lequel les États-Unis avaient déposé une plainte diplomatique officielle concernant la manière dont la Russie avait géré ce décès, exhortant Moscou à faire preuve d'une plus grande transparence sur cet incident. Le porte-parole du Kremlin a déclaré que la plupart des informations relayées au sujet de cet incident étaient fausses et que la population devait se fier aux informations communiquées par l'agence nationale de surveillance sanitaire Rospotrebnadzor. Dmitri Peskov a précisé qu'aucun entretien téléphonique n'était prévu pour l'instant entre le président russe Vladimir Poutine et Donald Trump, qui a déclaré mardi qu'il s'entretiendrait "très prochainement" avec Vladimor Poutine à ce sujet.

item.title: Leilão do pré-sal negocia 7 áreas para Petrobras, Prio, Equinor, Galp, Sinopec e CNOOC
item.description: Sete blocos exploratórios de petróleo e gás no pré-sal foram arrematados nesta quarta-feira por empresas como Petrobras, Prio Forte, Equinor, Galp, Sinopec e CNOOC, em leilão que não registrou disputas, de acordo com resultados apresentados pela Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP).
item.dc:creator: Marta Nogueira, Rodrigo Viga Gaier
item.content:encoded: Sete blocos exploratórios de petróleo e gás no pré-sal foram arrematados nesta quarta-feira por empresas como Petrobras, Prio Forte, Equinor, Galp, Sinopec e CNOOC, em leilão que não registrou disputas, de acordo com resultados apresentados pela Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP). Seis blocos ofertados, contudo, não tiveram interesse, já que o mercado considera que grande parte dos blocos do pré-sal com potenciais maiores já foi comercializada pelo governo brasileiro. O leilão resultou em uma arrecadação de R$530,47 milhões em bônus fixos de assinatura à União, que também levou dos arrematantes o direito de parte do petróleo a ser produzido no futuro. O investimento exploratório previsto nas áreas somou R$778,43 milhões, de acordo com o balanço apresentado pela ANP. A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) arrematou os blocos Azurita, na Bacia de Campos, e Cruzeiro do Sul, na Bacia de Santos, oferecendo percentuais de excedente em óleo de 30,0% e 15,27%, respectivamente. Os ágios em relação ao excedente mínimo de óleo alcançaram 139,81% em Azurita e 8,07% em Cruzeiro do Sul, segundo dados da ANP. A operação com maior ágio da rodada foi registrada no bloco Rodocrosita, na Bacia de Santos, arrematado por consórcio formado pela norueguesa Equinor e a portuguesa Galp. O lance vencedor ofereceu excedente em óleo de 15,52% para a União, um ágio de 494,64% ante o percentual mínimo previsto. A brasileira Prio foi a vencedora dos blocos Magnetita e Hematita, ambos na Bacia de Campos. Em Magnetita, a empresa ofertou excedente em óleo de 32,8% para a União, com ágio de 132,79%, enquanto em Hematita apresentou proposta de 7,18%, equivalente a ágio de 315,03%. O bloco Jade foi vencido pelo consórcio formado pelas chinesas CNOOC e Sinopec, com oferta de 18,2% de excedente em óleo para a União, representando ágio de 65,76%. Já o bloco Rubi foi arrematado pela Equinor Brasil, com oferta de 25,02% de excedente em óleo e ágio de 91,72%. Os blocos Turmalina, Larimar, Aragonita, Opala, Granada e Cerussita não receberam oferta.

item.title: Exportação de carne de frango do Brasil cresce em setembro com antecipação de cargas para UE
item.description: As exportações brasileiras de carne de frango totalizaram 500,3 mil toneladas em setembro, alta de 3,7% sobre o mesmo mês de 2025, com uma antecipação de maiores fluxos para a União Europeia, que proibiu a produção nacional certificada após o dia 3, afirmou a Associação Brasileira de Proteína Animal (ABPA) nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As exportações brasileiras de carne de frango totalizaram 500,3 mil toneladas em setembro, alta de 3,7% sobre o mesmo mês de 2025, com uma antecipação de maiores fluxos para a União Europeia, que proibiu a produção nacional certificada após o dia 3, afirmou a Associação Brasileira de Proteína Animal (ABPA) nesta quarta-feira. A receita alcançou US$984,2 milhões, avanço de 14,7% na mesma comparação. A União Europeia foi o segundo principal destino da carne de frango brasileira em setembro, com 43,5 mil toneladas, ante apenas 3,9 mil toneladas no mesmo período do ano passado. O aumento se deve a uma antecipação de embarques, mas também a uma pequena base de comparação --no mesmo período do ano passado, os embarques ainda eram pressionados por embargos sanitários decorrentes de um caso de gripe aviária em granja comercial. No caso da União Europeia, o resultado de setembro de 2026 inclui cargas produzidas e certificadas até 2 de setembro, explicou o presidente da ABPA, Ricardo Santin, em nota. A suspensão temporária da emissão de novos certificados para a UE entrou em vigor no dia 3, sem impedir o embarque dos produtos que já haviam cumprido essa etapa, acrescentou ele. A antecipação de volumes por exportadores e importadores também contribuiu para reduzir os efeitos imediatos da medida, disse Santin. A União Europeia retirou o Brasil da lista de países autorizados a exportar depois que considerou que o país não cumpriu normas sobre antimicrobianos. Os Emirados Árabes Unidos foram o principal destino da carne de frango brasileira em setembro, com 45,9 mil toneladas, volume 23,3% superior na comparação anual. Já a China importou 40,9 mil toneladas, ante somente 51 toneladas em setembro de 2025 -- os chineses levaram mais tempo para retomar compras do produto brasileiro, após o caso de gripe aviária em maio do ano passado. No acumulado de janeiro a setembro, os embarques do maior exportador global de carne de frango chegaram a 4,4 milhões de toneladas, crescimento de 14% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. A receita acumulada atingiu US$8,7 bilhões, avanço de 21%, segundo a ABPA.

item.title: Wildfire ash turns Spanish mountain river black, contaminating water supply
item.description: A river running through a town in central Spain has turned black from wildfire ash and debris, contaminating the local drinking water and forcing residents to rely on emergency supplies.
item.dc:creator: Susana Vera
item.content:encoded: A river running through a town in central Spain has turned black from wildfire ash and debris, contaminating the local drinking water and forcing residents to rely on emergency supplies. In the town of Casavieja in Avila province, where fast mountain streams flow into the Tietar River, the churning waters were inky black from ash-laden runoff. Residents queued at fountains and tanker trucks to fill canisters with clear drinking water, and authorities distributed water in bottles. "To drink, to cook, for the bathroom, for everything. Water: you only realize how much you need it once you don't have it anymore," said resident Miguel Angel Perez Sanchez. Casavieja Mayor Vanessa Muñoz said torrential rains had compounded the damage caused by the fires, washing away bridges and carrying runoff into a reservoir that serves as a backup water source for the town. "It affected us mainly because it entered the reservoir, which was our water supply and our emergency plan when the first rains arrived," she told the regional broadcaster Castilla y Leon TV. Santiago M. Barajas, an agronomist and co-founder of environmental group Ecologistas en Accion, wrote on X: "The impacts of the fires continue after they have been extinguished." "After torrential rains, the water barely filters into the soil without vegetation and rushes away muddy at great speed, as if the ashes had made it impermeable." In the nearby town of Piedralaves, authorities and water utility Aqualia were working to restore normal supplies after ash washed into water catchments following recent rains, prompting officials to declare tap water unfit for consumption. The affected area lies downstream from the Burgohondo wildfire in Avila, one of Spain's largest blazes this year, which burned 33,943 hectares (83,875 acres), accounting for more than 15% of the total area destroyed by wildfires nationwide, according to Environment Ministry data. Jose Maria Manso, mayor of nearby El Barraco, said ash and sediment could eventually reach the El Burguillo reservoir, a key source of drinking water for surrounding communities.

item.title: US SEC will not pursue charges against climate group, warns of disclosure obligations
item.description: The US Securities and Exchange Commission disclosed in a report on Wednesday that it had investigated the actions of a climate group in connection with a May 2021 ExxonMobil shareholder meeting and has chosen not to pursue charges against it.
item.dc:creator: Chris Prentice, Ross Kerber
item.content:encoded: The US Securities and Exchange Commission disclosed in a report on Wednesday that it had investigated the actions of a climate group in connection with a May 2021 ExxonMobil shareholder meeting and has chosen not to pursue charges against it. But the SEC warned that it had concerns about actions by the group, known as Climate Action 100+, and said that ahead of the 2027 proxy season, large shareholders need to understand their regulatory obligations. Climate Action 100+ and ExxonMobil did not respond immediately to a request for comment. Exxon's shareholder meeting in 2021 became a flashpoint in a broader debate about how much investors -- and Corporate America -- should take account of nontraditional factors, such as climate change issues, in their decision-making. At the meeting, major investment firms including BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street backed some dissident directors from a slate put forward by activist hedge fund Engine No. 1, which argued the Texas company needed to focus on the energy transition. Since then, various Republican politicians, often from energy-producing states, have harshly criticized asset managers over their environmental and social stances, saying their attention could violate antitrust laws.

item.title: Colômbia revoga decreto que limitava investimentos de fundos de pensão no exterior
item.description: O governo recém-empossado da Colômbia revogou um decreto que limitava os investimentos de fundos de pensão privados no exterior a 30%, afirmou o ministro da Fazenda, Miguel Gomez, nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O governo recém-empossado da Colômbia revogou um decreto que limitava os investimentos de fundos de pensão privados no exterior a 30%, afirmou o ministro da Fazenda, Miguel Gomez, nesta quarta-feira. O decreto anterior, emitido em abril passado pelo governo do ex-presidente Gustavo Petro, tinha como objetivo obrigar os fundos de pensão a repatriar capital para impulsionar investimentos em infraestrutura e projetos econômicos nacionais. “Ao remover essa restrição, os fundos poderão diversificar melhor suas carteiras, acessar mais mercados e buscar retornos mais elevados”, disse Gomez em uma mensagem gravada. A associação setorial Asofondos informou que as gestoras de fundos privados da Colômbia, entre as quais se incluem Porvenir, Proteccion, Colfondos e Old Mutual, administram uma carteira combinada de aproximadamente 579 trilhões de pesos (US$179 bilhões) em nome de quase 20 milhões de participantes. A regra anterior exigia a repatriação gradual de mais de 100 trilhões de pesos (US$30,9 bilhões) para a economia colombiana, segundo a Asofondos. Atualmente, os investimentos estrangeiros representam aproximadamente 48% da carteira total dos fundos, o que equivale a quase 278 trilhões de pesos (US$85,8 bilhões). O decreto anterior corria o risco de provocar uma forte valorização do peso em relação ao dólar e elevar artificialmente os preços dos ativos domésticos. “Estamos corrigindo essa política antes que ela entre em vigor e tenha qualquer impacto significativo”, acrescentou Gomez. (Reportagem de Carlos Vargas e Nelson Bocanegra)

item.title: Wall Street abre em baixa com alta de rendimentos de títulos e petróleo e com ata do Fed no foco
item.description: Os principais índices de Wall Street abriram em baixa nesta quarta-feira, com os rendimentos dos Treasuries e os preços do petróleo voltando a subir, o que mantinha os investidores cautelosos enquanto aguardam a ata da reunião de setembro do Federal Reserve.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices de Wall Street abriram em baixa nesta quarta-feira, com os rendimentos dos Treasuries e os preços do petróleo voltando a subir, o que mantinha os investidores cautelosos enquanto aguardam a ata da reunião de setembro do Federal Reserve. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caía 0,63% na abertura, para 51.196,22 pontos. O S&P 500 (.SPX) recuava 0,42%, a 7.786,33 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha queda de 0,56%, para 27.444,06 pontos. (Reportagem de Shashwat Chauhan em Bengaluru)

item.title: Retaining key LIV players an 'achievable hurdle' for new investors
item.description: LIV Golf faces a challenge to retain key players as the professional men's league restructures under Chapter 11 protection but it is a 'very achievable hurdle in a short period of time", the head of new investors BC Partners Credit said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: LIV Golf faces a challenge to retain key players as the professional men's league restructures under Chapter 11 protection but it is a 'very achievable hurdle in a short period of time", the head of new investors BC Partners Credit said on Wednesday. With financial backing from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) drying up, LIV last month started a [USN:L4N4501MD TEXT:"court-supervised restructuring process"] that it hopes to complete in early 2027. BC Partners Credit [USN:L4N45R1JI TEXT:"announced on Monday"] an initial committed investment and said it planned to provide up to $300 million in financing. Ted Goldthorpe, partner and head of BC Partners Credit, told the Leaders Week London sports business conference that he saw LIV as a great opportunity. "Every layer of the onion that we peel back on this thing, the more excited we are about the investment," he said. "The thing that's really fun about this one is in all of our other leagues, the players are on the other side of the table. In this situation, the players are our partners.
